plate-armor.name: Plate Armor
plate-armor.description: +1 armor every round, on top of the shield

shadow-cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow-cloak.description: The first enemy hit on the Rogue each battle misses

poisoners-kit.name: Poisoner's Kit
poisoners-kit.description: Poison the Rogue applies lasts 1 more round

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: The Axe also hits a second enemy for half its damage

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: Once per round, the Warrior takes an enemy attack meant for an ally below 25% HP

blessed-ward.name: Blessed Ward
blessed-ward.description: Heals also grant +2 armor for the round

smite.name: Smite
smite.description: Cleric attacks deal 3 more damage to undead (the Crypt) and dragonkin

hunters-mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters-mark.description: New utility (3 energy): the marked enemy takes 2 more damage from every hit this round

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.description: The Longbow gains 3 energy instead of 2

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Rogue attacks deal 3 more damage to toppled, taunted or cursed enemies

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: New utility (2 energy, once per battle): untargetable for a round

arcane-surge.name: Arcane Surge
arcane-surge.description: The first spell each round costs 1 less energy

evocation.name: Evocation
evocation.description: Spells that hit several enemies deal 1 more damage to each
